page.overview:
Who is Nathaniel Trapp?

is a veteran of the recent war in Newfaire, and a journalist for the Civil Tribune newspaper. He is played by Travis Willingham.

Nathaniel's clothing looks expensive, although he tries to hide it. He wears a pocket watch, a beard, and two weathered but currently empty leather holsters. He has piercing blue eyes. After the events of , the right eye's vision turned completely white but the only outward sign was a slight discoloration to the pupil and some creeping scarring that he attempted to disguise with makeup. After the attack at the Chapter House in , he carried an officer's revolver in one of the holsters.

When Nathaniel was nine years old, his older brother was caught by waves as he waded out into a river to fetch one of Nathaniel's toys, and instead of helping him, Nathaniel froze and watched him drown.

Nathaniel was Marion and Sean's former lieutenant and commanding officer in the army.
